promotions.body:
## Perfect Practice Pass
Unlock one eligible track for 30 days, ideal for an exercise you repeat often.

Choose the track you teach with most. A Perfect Practice Pass unlocks it for 30 days, however often you play it.

## Separate from Day Passes
A Day Pass unlocks Cadance for the teaching day. A Perfect Practice Pass unlocks one selected track for 30 days.

Find Perfect Practice Passes in Settings or in an eligible track's action menu.

## Teach with a Day Pass
One pass gives full access until midnight. Passes never expire.

Without a subscription, Cadance is in Class Planning mode: every track plays a 15-second preview, so you can plan a class without using a pass.

When a track plays past 15 seconds and you have a Day Pass, Cadance counts down 10 seconds, then starts your teaching day. Tap **Don't use a pass** to keep planning instead.

When the countdown no longer appears, leave Class Planning mode by tapping **Activate a Day Pass Now** under Day Passes in Settings.
